cur:objects2-shemokmedi-crucifixion-quat.summary: On a small quatrefoil of gold, about 8 cm high, the crucified Christ hangs on a dark cross beneath the inscription tablet, flanked by the Virgin and Saint John and by two angels above; Greek-letter inscriptions surround the scene. The brilliant colours of the enamel against the gold ground make the image glow like a jewel. It came from the monastery of Shemokmedi in western Georgia, whose treasury preserved many Georgian and Byzantine precious objects.
facts: The Commons record gives its size as 8 × 7.2 cm and describes it as cellular (cloisonné) enamel on a golden ground.
The Shemokmedi treasury, in Guria, also held the Transfiguration icon brought from Zarzma monastery in the 16th century.
